## Apple launches research study to explore the use of AI for health

## Media

• Text of this article November 15, 2026 UPDATE Apple launches research study to explore the use of AI for health The Apple Health AI Usage Study, conducted in collaboration with OpenEvidence, will evaluate trust, comprehension, and real-world health AI engagement Apple today announced the launch of the Apple Health AI Usage Study in the United States, a virtual research study and associated app designed to advance the understanding of how people interact with conversational health AI tools. 1 By examining what drives user trust, the quality of responses, comprehension, and everyday health actions, the study aims to inform the responsible design of health AI experiences for Apple and the industry. “At Apple, we believe responsible innovation starts with scientific rigor and clinical grounding. Health is deeply personal, and conducting a dedicated research study is the most thoughtful way to understand how people engage with, comprehend, and evaluate health AI in everyday life,” said Sumbul Desai, M.D., Apple’s vice president of Health and Fitness. “Insights from this study will help advance the broader scientific conversation and ensure that as technology evolves, we continue building trusted tools that genuinely support people wherever they are on their health journey.” The study is conducted in collaboration with OpenEvidence, a leading clinical AI platform widely used by healthcare professionals that generates answers using medical information from established sources such as The New England Journal of Medicine , Journal of the American Medical Association , and Nature . The study brings together medically grounded AI technology developed by OpenEvidence with an Apple-designed research experience. Participants will be able to ask the study app everyday health questions; explore complex medical information communicated with approachable language; and see linked, peer-reviewed clinical citations that ground each response.
